system.summary: Highlights work as a permanent sales page in five sections: who I am (ARISTOCRAT), proof from clients in their own voice (TESTIMONY), proof as numbers (RESULTS), the offer (JOIN NEXUS) and hiring (HIRING). Every designed frame ends in a reply keyword, so a Story reply becomes a DM conversation.
system.cta_model: Reply-with-keyword, never a link sticker. Keywords seen: LAST TIME, NEXUS, VIRAL FLOW, EDITOR, SETTER. The keyword sits low in the frame with an arrow pointing down toward Instagram's reply bar.

brand_system.key_value_marker: the number or result in each headline sits in a red rectangle (e.g. [65K VIEWS], [$12K CONVERSION])

kit_mapping.note: How each Devin habit matches the Full Visual kit rules (artifacts/creative/2026-10-20-full-visual-bland-claude/.claude/skills/full-visual*).

rules.devin: Headline names a real person and a number: 'RYAN HITTING 250K VIEWS IN JUST 48 HOURS'
rules.kit: Hook test 1 and 3: a real named thing in the first four words, a number

rules.devin: One win per frame, same skeleton every time (name, result, time, screenshot, arrow)
rules.kit: Repeated proof unit: your thing, what happened, the number, what it means; the last one escalates
One key word per caption block in the selection box
Real material only; redraw only the parts the sentence needs
Every change belongs to a word: the static version is a visible link from claim to evidence
A change of state happens to the object already on screen (before and after of one account)
CTA says exactly what arrives: comment KEYWORD and I'll send it

rules.devin: Same dark template on every proof frame
rules.kit: One continuous thing per reel: the template is the thread that turns many wins into one sequence

differs_from_kit: Stories are tapped, not heard: no voice clock, so sync becomes layout (headline, then evidence, then arrow, top to bottom).
Several screenshots per frame (up to 3) where the kit wants one focus; Devin keeps one hero screenshot big and the rest smaller.

sequence_types.pattern: Every frame is one client win on the dark template. Every 3 to 4 frames a CTA frame. One 'COMMUNITY WINS DUMP' title card opens a new run (frame 7). It ends on selfie frames that say why it works.

sequence_types.pattern: Raw client selfie videos (4 to 60 s, long ones split into 60 s chunks), captions burned in by the client or Devin, the client's @handle bottom right. No template, no graphics beyond captions; the proof is the person talking.

Candid moments that show the life the business pays for (terrace view, studio shoot, his set, night city, first-class to Dubai, Dubai balcony, a lighter 'listen to the ping', speaking on stage, group yacht trip with an Ask Me Anything box). Text is one short lowercase serif line or none.

frame_template.text: one short line, small, lowercase italic serif

sequence_types.pattern: One frame: his photo, verified handle, 'JOIN NEXUS.', a one-line promise ('Helping Online Business Owners Create Predictable & Profitable Content'), REPLY WITH "NEXUS" and a row of down arrows.
One frame per role: avatar, 'HIRING {ROLE}' in a role colour, 2 to 3 requirement pills, pay range, REPLY WITH "{ROLE}" in a box.

3. Sequence builder: proof_stack becomes 'one win per frame, a reply-keyword frame every 3 to 4', opened by a 'WINS DUMP' title card; keyword maps to an existing dm_keyword_assets row so a Story reply gets the resource.
4. Lifestyle frames stay (ARISTOCRAT model) with one short line, matched by the photo tags built on Oct 20.

6. Testimonials only if Antonio has client videos with permission.

live_sequence_model.idea: Turn each owned long-form YouTube video (src/publishing/youtube-longform.json, 13 videos) into one 8-frame teaching Story on this grammar, ending with Reply "KEYWORD" and I'll send it, where the keyword's DM sends that video.
steps: 1. Script: write the 8 beats from the video's own transcript with the kit script rules (verdict hook, old way, mechanism named, example, state change, turn with a felt number, lesson, CTA naming the video). Antonio approves the words.
2. Visual plan: one real object per beat (our logos, Antonio's photos, our dashboards, the YouTube thumbnail); one diagram that changes across 3 frames.
3. Render: HTML templates at 1080x1920 in headless Chrome (as the kit covers), or kit engine stills when the Story comes from a kit reel.
4. Keyword: a dm_keyword_assets row per video that sends the YouTube link.
5. Publish through the existing Story slots once one Story pilot is approved on the phone.

live_sequence_2026_10_21.summary: An 8-frame tap-through explainer: one thesis taught step by step, one diagram that changes state across three frames, then a reply keyword that sends his YouTube video. This is the Full Visual kit script as Story frames, and it is the sequence type Antonio wants to model.
live_sequence_2026_10_21.goal: Move Story viewers to a long-form YouTube video through a DM keyword (Reply "EXPERT").

frames.text: SOCIAL MEDIA IS [DEAD] / We're in a new era, and it's adapt or be [left behind] 👉
frames.visual: real-looking tombstone carved with the Instagram, X, Facebook and YouTube logos in a cemetery, full bleed
frames.kit: Hook formula 'Verdict': a real thing the viewer knows in the first words, a side someone could argue with, red box on the key word

frames.text: Social media used to be built on Social networks / The content you saw was based on the people you follow / Not any more 👉
frames.visual: Devin on his phone with a network of avatar bubbles orbiting him
frames.kit: Bridge: the belief the viewer already holds, ending on a turn that pulls the next tap

frames.text: Now we're in the era of INTEREST MEDIA / The content you see is only based on topics you're interested in / So how do you adapt? 👉
frames.visual: same orbit, now labelled with topic chips (Marketing, Business)
frames.kit: Show what happens, then name it ('And this is what's called...'); the same orbit object changes state instead of being replaced

frames.text: Imagine you're a sales coach and you make content about 3 topics
frames.visual: diagram: 'You' avatar with dashed lines to three photo cards (Fitness, Sales, Lifestyle content)
frames.kit: One continuous thing: this diagram carries frames 4 to 6

frames.text: Each topic will [attract] a different group of people
frames.visual: same diagram, each card now shows 33% / 33% / 34% Audience in its own colour
frames.kit: A number lands on the object already on screen

frames.text: Which means [67%] of your content will attract an audience that will never buy from you
frames.visual: same diagram, Fitness and Lifestyle stamped NON-BUYERS in red, Sales card dimmed
frames.kit: The turn: one fact that flips the frame; change of state on the same cards (stamp, dim) rather than a new picture

frames.text: So to attract the most buyers / All of your reels should be [demonstrations of your expertise] / And save the rest for your stories
frames.visual: his own reel (720K views) above, his own Story (a poll) below, split by a divider
frames.kit: Real material: his own reel and Story as the proof of the rule

frames.text: This video shows you how to succeed in the new era 👇 / Reply ["EXPERT"] and I'll send it to you

frames.kit: CTA: reply KEYWORD and I'll send it, with the exact thing that arrives shown on screen

grammar.layout: text top third, centred, sentence case white, one key phrase coloured (red for the cost, green for the gain) or boxed; visual in the middle; reply bar left clear
grammar.pull: frames 1 to 3 end with a pointing-hand line ('Not any more 👉', 'So how do you adapt? 👉'), a written re-hook that earns the next tap
grammar.continuity: two continuous objects: the orbit (frames 2 to 3) and the You-to-3-cards diagram (frames 4 to 6); each frame changes the object, never swaps it
grammar.material: real logos, his own photos, his own reel, Story and YouTube thumbnail; nothing generic
grammar.length: 8 frames, one idea, about 25 to 40 seconds of tapping
grammar.ground: dark, his own photo dimmed behind the diagram frames
